newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS- Spreads hold amid heavy supply.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS- Spreads hold amid heavy supply.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond spreads held their ground on Wednesday amid the marketing of more than $4 billion in taxable fixed-income, dealers said.

The largest of the issues, a multi-tranche $2.8 billion taxable global bond deal from New Jersey Economic Development Authority, drew strong interest from corporate buyers with municipal and corporate traders calling it "well-subscribed".

New Jersey's offering includes a $1.3 billion fixed-rate tranche with a final maturity in 2029 formally priced at 66 basis points over the 6.50 percent November 2025 U.S. Treasury and $1.5 billion in zero coupon bonds.
